introduction: Kern CalWORKs offers cash support and related services for eligible families. County DHS reviews applications and participation needs.
description: Kern CalWORKs offers cash support and related services for eligible families. County DHS reviews applications and participation needs.

sections.who: The program serves qualifying low-income families with children. Household circumstances and program rules affect eligibility.
sections.get: Approved support may include cash, employment services and eligible family supports. Ask about housing or home-visiting services when relevant.
sections.docs:
• Household and child information.
  • Income, resources and other county-requested verification.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use BenefitsCal or contact Kern DHS.

  2. Complete intake

    Return requested evidence and attend the county interview.

  3. Discuss barriers

    Tell the worker about disability or health conditions affecting applications or participation.
sections.after: Read the notice and assigned requirements. Request an accommodation when needed rather than missing a required appointment.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Kern CalWORKs; CDSS CalWORKs. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: It is cash assistance and related family services; CalFresh is separate.
Tell DHS and ask about accommodations.
Ask DHS which services apply to the case.
